method: Complete pinned Kotlin image editor source read in six bounded chunks1-1249. Static preview/coordinate/save review only.
findings: Save chooses PNG for png,WEBP for webp, otherwise JPEG while retaining original extension. GIF/BMP/etc edited output can have JPEG bytes under old suffix; static branch confirmed, no Android encoding run. Animated image/color metadata preservation not established.

Save calls Bitmap.compress but ignores Boolean; then recycles final bitmap, shows success and invokes onSaved. Stream close exceptions caught, false encoder result not. Partial destination cleanup absent on exception. No failed-write probe.

Original file not overwritten by intended naming: selects basename_edited then numbered suffix while exists. exists-check followed by FileOutputStream not exclusive creation/atomic publication; concurrent saver could race. No action against originals executed.

Save synchronous directly from Button.onClick; decodes source full resolution, transforms, allocates final ARGB8888, compresses/writes on calling UI thread. Preview Coil request Size.ORIGINAL. No pixel/memory cap or latency measurement; do not claim specific slowdown.

Crop uses coerceIn(0,tW-10)/coerceIn(10,tW-x) similarlyheight. When transformed width/height below10, bounds invalid. Exception surfaces Save failed, not fallback. Ordinary UI Transform tab click enables crop even if no explicit Crop Box toggle.

Fit mapping treats any nonzero rotation modulo180 as width/height swap, including fine rotation1degree. Actual rotated bounds depend on sin/cos. Preview rotates full-size fitted layer whereas save transforms source into new bounding bitmap, so crop/drawing mapping can diverge. No rendered geometry qualification.

Draw overlay points stored in screen coordinates. New image/container changes do not reset remember state; drawing gesture pointerInput keyed onlycategory while fitRect changes. Preview drawings remain screen overlay and save maps against latest fit dimensions. Orientation/resize/rotation parity requires device fixture.

Aspect lock uses entirecontainer not image visible rect, then save clips screen coordinates to transformed bitmap. Aspect ratio can change after clipping letterbox region. Minimum crop10pixels differs screen touch threshold36dp.

Crop may return same Bitmap object for full-region crop; code recycles transformed when transformed!=srcBitmap before assigning cropped. Bitmap alias behavior requires Android contract/runtime; do not claim definitive use-after-recycle. General exception cleanup lacks finally for allocated intermediate/final bitmaps.

HIGH_CONTRAST composes1.4scale/-30 then calls setToSaturation1.3 on same matrix; setter composition semantics need Compose implementation/runtime to establish whether prior contrast overwritten. No unchanged Kotlin control run.
EXIF orientation/color profile/animation/frame metadata are not explicitly read/copied in save; Coil preview decoding path may differ BitmapFactory raw save. No image file or private media inspected.

Undo/Redo limiteddrawPaths, not general edit history; reset clears drawing/filter/crop state. Save enabled even no changes and can reencode original. This creates a distinct encoded file, not byte duplicate proof.
candidate_requirements_for_library: Infer file format from validated content as well as suffix; preserve explicit conversion identity.
Do not report successful save on false encoder result; publish output atomically with verified status.
Exercise tiny images, orientation, arbitrary rotations, animation and metadata when qualifying image equivalence.
limits: No Android/Compose/Coil bitmap runtime, encoding, image rendering, user-file writes or Kotlin tests executed.
No production library changes;155/500 full repository count unchanged.
